scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && dotnet build apps/api/Api.slnx -c Release && npm run build --workspace infra
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace apps/web && dotnet test apps/api/tests/Web.UnitTests/Web.UnitTests.csproj && dotnet test apps/api/tests/Application.UnitTests/Application.UnitTests.csproj && npm run test --workspace infra
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace infra
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace apps/web && npm run format --workspace infra && dotnet format apps/api/Api.slnx
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace apps/web && npm run format:check --workspace infra && dotnet format apps/api/Api.slnx --verify-no-changes
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace infra
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && dotnet clean apps/api/Api.slnx
